name: Embedded & Linux Kernel
blurb: Short videos only: every pick is 20 minutes or less and covers one or two ideas, ordered as a sequence. Subtopics follow the Embedded C and Embedded Linux guides in Topics.
method:
• Length: hard cap of 20 minutes per video; depth comes from a sequence.
  • Order: picks in a subtopic are in watching order; the first is the starting point.
  • Sources: Miro Samek (Quantum Leaps) for bare-metal C on Cortex-M, Shawn Hymel (Digi-Key) for FreeRTOS, Johannes 4GNU_Linux for Linux drivers, Rohde & Schwarz for buses.

subtopics.name: Short-video courses
subtopics.note: Every video on this page is 20 minutes or less. Digi-Key's RTOS series and the early Quantum Leaps lessons fit; Johannes 4GNU_Linux covers drivers.
